arguments.message: The SSO button only shows up if your workspace has SSO enabled for your email domain **and** the identity‑provider sync has created your account. Ask an admin to go to **Settings → People** and verify that your account is listed as an SSO‑provisioned user (it will show the IdP name). If it’s missing, the sync hasn’t created it yet, so the SSO sign‑in option won’t appear.
